original.target_description: Single experiment (Study 1): 2 Anchor × 2 Time Pressure ANOVA interaction on probability estimates of an epidemic; main dependent variable on supplied PDF p. 5.

n.sample_role: Students across all four between-participant ANOVA cells
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; sixty-two enrolled and residual df=58 for four-cell model.
n.quote: Sixty-two students of Leiden University participated

replication.target_description: Study 2: primary 2 × 2 ANOVA interaction of anchor (10 vs. 90) with time pressure on estimates of the probability of lung pestilence in India; entire final analytic sample. This is the primary candidate test; the supplied broad locator does not uniquely distinguish the interaction from the two main effects.

n.quote: The remaining sample was reduced to the target sample size of N = 170, and 80% power was thus achieved.
n.exclusions: 175 completed; three excluded for recognizing anchoring or subliminal perception; remaining sample reduced to target 170. None excluded for probabilities over 100% or too few correct letter responses. The text does not explain which other two were removed.

es.quote: Whereas we hypothesized a Time Pressure × Anchor interaction, no such effect was present, F(1, 166) = 0.11, p = .743, f = 0.025, 95% CI = [0, 0.155].

p.quote: Whereas we hypothesized a Time Pressure × Anchor interaction, no such effect was present, F(1, 166) = 0.11, p = .743, f = 0.025, 95% CI = [0, 0.155].

reported_success.quote: In our high-powered, preregistered, close replication of Reitsma-van Rooijen et al. (2006), we could not replicate the subliminal anchoring effect that they reported for participants who had to provide their estimates quickly.

notes:
The three assigned IDs have identical neutral descriptions, studies, metrics and locators. Extracted the preregistered primary Anchor × Time Pressure interaction for each; no assignment of different tests from input order. The same section also prints anchor main effect F(1, 166) = 1.04, p = .310, f = 0.079, and time-pressure main effect F(1, 166) = 0.06, p = .810, f = 0.019; the supplied locators do not distinguish those effects. Original full text unavailable after bounded open-access acquisition. Original statistics quoted by replication authors were not substituted for a primary-original extraction.
Source follow-up: All three assigned rows have identical neutral descriptions and original locators; each receives the same main-dependent-variable interaction printed on PDF p. 5. The separate time-pressure manipulation check F=8.56 tests response latency and is not the probability-estimate outcome. The simple anchor contrast under time pressure t(28)=2.37, p<.05 is on PDF p. 6, and is not substituted for the located interaction. Canonical TXT substitutes D for the equals glyph; numerics verified on rendered primary PDF pp. 5–6.
